shikigami.name: Divine Dogs
shikigami.description: Two divine canine familiars that track and attack with relentless precision.

conquestRequirement.description: Defeat Divine Dogs at 10% power in ritual combat

shikigami.name: Nue
shikigami.description: A winged shikigami that unleashes lightning from the sky.

conquestRequirement.description: Must conquer Divine Dogs first, then defeat Nue at 10% power

shikigami.name: Great Serpent
shikigami.description: A massive serpentine shikigami that constricts and crushes its prey.

conquestRequirement.description: Must conquer Nue first, then defeat Great Serpent at 10% power

shikigami.name: Toad
shikigami.description: An amphibious shikigami that absorbs cursed energy and launches counterattacks.

conquestRequirement.description: Must conquer Great Serpent first, then defeat Toad at 10% power

shikigami.name: Rabbit Escape
shikigami.description: A fleet-footed shikigami that confuses enemies and creates escape routes.

conquestRequirement.description: Must conquer Toad first, then defeat Rabbit Escape at 10% power

shikigami.name: Max Elephant
shikigami.description: A heavyweight shikigami that crushes enemies with water and massive force.

conquestRequirement.description: Must conquer Rabbit Escape first, then defeat Max Elephant at 10% power

shikigami.name: Round Deer
shikigami.description: A holy shikigami that purifies cursed energy and heals allies.

conquestRequirement.description: Must conquer Max Elephant first, then defeat Round Deer at 10% power

shikigami.name: Piercing Ox
shikigami.description: A powerful bovine shikigami that charges through everything in its path.

conquestRequirement.description: Must conquer Round Deer first, then defeat Piercing Ox at 10% power

shikigami.name: Tiger Funeral
shikigami.description: A death omen shikigami whose roar withers enemies and heralds demise.

conquestRequirement.description: Must conquer Piercing Ox first, then defeat Tiger Funeral at 10% power

shikigami.name: Mourning Tiger
shikigami.description: A spectral tiger born from grief, striking with phantasmal claws.

conquestRequirement.description: Must conquer Tiger Funeral first, then defeat Mourning Tiger at 10% power

shikigami.name: Mahoraga
shikigami.description: The supreme divine general who adapts to any and all techniques. Defeating this shikigami at 10% power grants the pinnacle of the Ten Shadows.

conquestRequirement.description: Must conquer Mourning Tiger first. Then survive and defeat Mahoraga at 10% power. Requires: Grade Special, 1000 curse kills, all previous shikigami conquered.
